play_item.name: Play a Jellyfin item
play_item.description: Plays a Jellyfin movie, episode or video on a Google Cast TV through the official Jellyfin receiver, and waits until it plays. The response says ok, with the play method and session, or the error.

entity_id.name: TV
entity_id.description: Google Cast media player (the cast entity, not a universal one).

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: Jellyfin id of the movie, episode or video.

item_type.name: Item type
item_type.description: Jellyfin type of the item. An Episode makes the receiver queue the rest of the season when the user has next-episode autoplay on.

audio_stream_index.name: Audio track
audio_stream_index.description: Jellyfin stream index of the audio track (default: the server's choice).

subtitle_stream_index.name: Subtitle track
subtitle_stream_index.description: Jellyfin stream index of the subtitle track, -1 for none (default: the user's subtitle settings).

start_position_ticks.name: Start position
start_position_ticks.description: Where to start, in Jellyfin ticks (10,000,000 per second).

max_bitrate.name: Max bitrate
max_bitrate.description: Bitrate cap in bit/s (default: the receiver measures the network). It stays on the receiver until the app closes.

receiver_name.name: Receiver name
receiver_name.description: Device name of the Jellyfin session (default: the TV's name plus "Jellyfin"). Keep it stable per TV.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to wait for the TV to play it.
